name: Auriferous-Drumlin
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in bioluminescent seas. Travelers navigate by massive canyon systems and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
